name: ignore-sigterm
description: The kill-escalation fixture. Installs a no-op SIGTERM handler, backgrounds two `sleep 300` children so there is a real process tree to reach, announces their pids so a spec can find them, and then never exits on its own. Only SIGKILL ends this invocation, which is the whole point: without a process that genuinely survives SIGTERM, the escalation path is never executed.
